in_marathi.name: Shatrudhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shatrudhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shatru-dhana' meaning 'having a hundred weapons'. This name is often given to boys born into warrior families or those destined to defend their community. It symbolizes strength, courage, and loyalty.
